chunks: Ali ibn Isma'il al-Maythami from Hammad from Abd Allah ibn al-Mughira from Ibn Sinan from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him)

Regarding a man who divorced his wife, then he died while she was in her waiting period: she inherits him and observes the waiting period of the deceased for her husband. And if she died while in her waiting period, he inherits her. And each of them inherits from the blood-money of the other, if one were killed, provided that one did not kill the other.
ai.seo_question: What are the inheritance and iddah rules for a divorced wife if her husband dies before the divorce is finalized?
ai.summary: This narration from Imam al-Sadiq clarifies the legal status of a wife during the 'iddah of a revocable divorce (taliq) upon her husband's death, affirming her right to inherit as a widow. It further establishes the principle of mutual inheritance of blood-money (diyah) between spouses, contingent upon the absence of homicide, reflecting the Shia juristic view on the continuity of marital bonds until the final pronouncement. This ruling is significant in distinguishing between the effects of death and the finalization of divorce in Shia inheritance law.
